text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Thursday, January 31, 2019 Posted by admin on January 31st, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -93 points.
Wednesday the Dow was up +434.90 (+1.77%) at 25,014.86.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +7.23%.
There were 27 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Apple (AAPL) +6.83%, Boeing (BA) +6.25% and Microsoft (MSFT) +3.34%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Walmart (WMT) -1.97%, Disney (DIS) -0.69% and McDonald’s (MCD) -0.22%.
Unemployment insurance weekly claims in the week ending January 26, the advance figure for seasonally adjusted initial claims was 253,000, an increase of 53,000 from the previous week’s revised level. This is the highest level for initial claims since September 30, 2017 when it was 254,000. The previous week’s level was revised up by 1,000 from 199,000 to 200,000. The 4-week moving average was 220,250, an increase of 5,000 from the previous week’s revised average. The previous week’s average was revised up by 250 from 215,000 to 215,250.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is up three-tenths of a cent at $2.259 per gallon.
